title: tares capabilities --json: what this engine and the Tares it is signed in to can do

engine.description: The version of this tares, as `tares --version` shows it.

commands.description: The dotted names of the machine commands this engine has (`factory.status`, `factory.crew.up`, `login`, ...): the commands an app drives with `--json`: each prints a document with a schema in this folder, except `factory.settings` (Claude Code's settings file) and `factory.tidy` (nothing on success, the error shape on a refusal). A name that is not here is a command this engine does not have.

cell.description: What the Tares this machine is signed in to says at /health. Not signed in: url, version null and capabilities empty. Signed in but not answering, or answering something that is not a Tares: url set, version null, capabilities empty. Never an error.

url.description: The address of the Tares; null when none is named.

version.description: The Tares's version; null when it did not say.

capabilities.description: The names /health lists; empty when it lists none or did not answer.
